rejections.reason: The same transfer of live ornaments to a new shell is already taught by published2078 about an anemone-carrying hermit crab; species substitution is too close.
Rear teeth crushing shells is a routine feeding adaptation here, with weak distractors and too little independent curiosity.
A generic unpleasant defensive secretion is less distinctive than the retained ladybug leg-joint secretion and largely repeats that defense motif.
Reusing an abandoned burrow is ordinary ecological behavior; the question tests no sufficiently unusual part of the aardvark relationship.
